overview_description.description: Crypthulhu Studios develops blockchain-based gaming studios intended for Web3 gaming. Their blockchain technology runs on Web3, allowing collaboration between developers and gamers that utilizes distributed ledger technology to offer greater transparency, security, democratization, and user control over in-game assets, offering players a longer-lasting, immersive gaming experience to play RPG games seamlessly.

product.name: Dimension X on Flow
product.description: A free-to-play, play-to-earn strategic role-playing game set in the Dimension X comic book universe, where players use NFT heroes to go on quests, level up, and battle other players.

product.name: Dimension X on Ethereum
product.description: A free-to-play strategic RPG set in the Dimension X comic book universe, where players use NFT heroes to build teams, go on quests, and compete against other players to mint new heroes.

product.name: Dimension X Comics
product.description: Collectible NFTs that build out the lore of the Dimension X Universe and provide in-game utility by transforming hero skins and boosting their power levels.
